resources.string: Covers short videos while your coding agent works

Covers Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and TikTok with memes while your coding agent is working on your computer. Android only wakes it for those three apps. It goes online for one thing only, and only if a computer linked it: to ask whether your coding agent is working.
Covers Reels, Shorts and TikTok while your coding agent works.
Not linked to a coding agent yet. Your agent links it with agent link.
Turn it on in Accessibility settings. It is listed as Nomoredoom.

That happens when an app was installed from a file. Tap the grey switch once so Android shows its notice. Then open App info, tap the three dots at the top, then Allow restricted settings. Come back here and turn it on.

Android tells it when Instagram, YouTube or TikTok changes screens, and it checks whether the short-video player is the one showing. It reads no text and takes no screenshots. If a computer linked it to your coding agent, it asks one address whether the agent is working, and only while a short video is in front. Nothing about this phone goes with the question, but the times it asks show the service when you watch short videos.
